correctness.rationale: The six stationary balances reduce exactly to \(Q_\alpha(I)=0\) with positive reconstruction for all \(I>0\). At \(I=\alpha^{-1/(n-1)}y\) the smooth limiting equation has a simple positive root because \(\mathcal R_c<1\); at fixed \(I>0\) the high-alpha limit \(\Lambda/I-K\) has a separate simple positive root. Implicit-function arguments prove both for sufficiently large alpha. Disease-free linearization has \(g(0)=g\prime(0)=0\) and Hurwitz blocks for \(\mathcal R_c<1\). The explicit admissible \(\alpha=1000\), \(n=3\) witness has two distinct roots by exact rational interval signs and exactly two positive roots by exact Sturm count; the included checker reconstructs all six equations and the limiting values. Finite checks supplement, rather than replace, the general analytic proof.

value.rationale: The exact model whose earlier theory says generic local backward bifurcation is unavailable for \(n\ge3\) nevertheless has two coexisting subthreshold endemic states at strong environmental transmission, while its disease-free state remains locally exponentially stable. This identifies a meaningful boundary between invasion-local criteria and global equilibrium geometry, valid for every integer \(n\ge3\) and quantified by two nontrivial singular infection scales, not merely a routine numerical substitution. The exact rational witness supplies reproducible parameters. Neither branch stability nor direct epidemiological prediction is claimed.
